chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji‘abi, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me, saying: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Hadrami narrated to us, saying: Malik ibn Abdillah ibn Sayf narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Ma‘bad narrated to us, saying: Ishaq ibn Yahya al-Ka‘bi narrated to us, from Sufyan al-Thawri, from Mansur, from Rib‘i ibn Hirash, from Hudhayfa ibn al-Yaman who said: I heard the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace, say:

Allah will distinguish His sincere servants and His chosen ones, until the earth is cleansed of the hypocrites, those who have gone astray, and the descendants of those who have gone astray. And until there will be fifty women meeting a man on that day, this one saying: O servant of Allah, take me as a maid; and this one saying: O servant of Allah, give me refuge.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) say about the purification of the earth before the advent of the Hujja?
ai.summary: The Prophet (SAWW) prophesies that before the advent of the Hujja (proof of God), Allah will distinguish His sincere servants and chosen ones, purifying the earth of hypocrites and those who have gone astray and their descendants. The situation will become so dire that fifty women will approach a single man, each begging him to take her as a servant or give her refuge. This hadith, narrated through Hudhayfa ibn al-Yaman who was known as the keeper of the Prophet's secrets about end-times tribulations (fitan), describes the social upheaval and moral collapse that precedes the coming of the Mahdi.
